sloka: तिष्ठ मा मा गमः पुत्र यमस्य सदनम् प्रति ।श्वो मया सह गन्ता असि जनन्या च समेधितः ॥२-६४-३७॥
transliteration: tiṣṭha mā mā gamaḥ putra yamasya sadanam prati ।śvo mayā saha gantā asi jananyā ca samedhitaḥ ॥2-64-37॥

translations.english: 'My dear son, stay with me, do not go (now) to the abode of Yama, (lord of death). Tomorrow accompanied by me and your mother you may
